_why: Backfilled from the link already committed as WoaSoloSpecLink.5.0.80;
re-encoding reproduces it byte for byte.
Buys the whole school-alternation loop, none of which the premade build
Gnosticism 2/2     (was Improved Mana Burn) shadow damage restores mana,
Killing Word 3/3   (was Silent Resolve) Shadow Word: Death scales with
the number of periodic effects on the target.
Funded by dropping Improved Flash Heal, Renewed Hope, Aspiration and Grace:
all four are healing-throughput talents whose value is in sustaining someone
else. Divine Aegis stays, because Alonecraft's version converts critical
*damage* into an absorb shield rather than critical healing.
Note the two Improved Power Word: Shield entries are distinct talents that
swapped names in the redesign -- T2.2 is the renamed Soul Warding and T4.2
is the renamed Improved Power Word: Shield. Both are wanted.
